scope: Independent source review of the frozen development-benchmark auditor; this file does not assert completion of the full data audit.
review: Release inspection binds the exact 10-case, four-repetition, four-path matrix, cap 4096, delta 0.01, seed rule, all three single-arm calibrations, six rational arms and both paired checkpoint schedules. Frozen production sources and their review artifacts are rehashed.

The saved 7141-model rational prior is read directly. Exact positivity, physical feasibility, uniqueness and total weight one are checked without relying on trigonometric regeneration. Independent summation preserves each selected model's original weight.
Every single-arm observation is reconstructed from its seed and actual chosen arm. The paid six-arm initialization is accounted for before PSR alternation or per-observation DKM updates.

DKM per-sign AdaHedge losses, mixing gaps, optimistic payoffs and cumulative-ratio tracking are reconstructed. KL confidence endpoints satisfy independent divergence equations, successful projections satisfy physical/confidence-box constraints, and each opposite-model response satisfies physical/sign constraints plus an independently assembled global convex-gap diagnostic.

For each released eligible checkpoint, both null-fit proposals, every active numerator/threshold screen, the eligible sign list and every resulting exact certificate are reconstructed. The greater certified evidence-minus-threshold margin selects the sign, with the prescribed positive tie break.

All checkpoints before each method's recorded stop are required and checked. Reconstructed first certified stop or forced-cap abstention must exactly match the stored outcome prefix. The shared path may continue only while another calibration is still active.

The paired auditor reconstructs all three binomial calls per block, paid pair counts, score, each Fisher expert CGF and the Beta/Fisher mixture screen. Every eligible paired checkpoint is required and checked until its first certified stop or cap.

The audit_refined.audit_certificate hedge call has the correct argument order and requires only fstate.blocks for this engine. Its returned decision, count, score, interval bounds and retained-term fields match the producer certificate schema.

The full audit requires 160 ordered path records, 320 matching method records, no extra ledger lines, all 320 terminal certificates and 80 exact original-runner seed replays selected as repetitions 0 and 3 of every case/path.

Unconditional costs, errors, abstentions and equal-case geometric cost ratios are independently reconstructed. Producer artifacts and audit sources are hashed before and after processing. Existing audit outputs are preserved by exclusive creation.
limits: This is source review. The separate benchmark_audit/audit.json must pass before the observed experiment is described as fully audited.
First-stop verification applies to the released monitoring and floating-screen protocol; it does not establish absence of hypothetical mathematical crossings outside that protocol.

The null-fit proposal optimizer, outward Decimal/null-support arithmetic, KK21 calibration primitive and conditional-CGF primitive are shared with reviewed frozen code. This is not a wholly independent mathematical implementation.

DKM projection optimality is not independently re-solved. The opposite-model global gap is a floating diagnostic with the released 1e-5 tolerance, not a proof of an exact oracle or inherited asymptotic efficiency.
The 80 same-seed replays use the original runner and support reproducibility; they are neither fresh independent experiments nor a second controller implementation.
At cap 4096 both closed-hedge paths remain in their PSR warm-up, so this pilot does not test actual closed-angle adaptation. The fine schedule also changes conditional-Fisher block partitions.

The benchmark is a small development diagnostic, uses development cases and computes no inferential confidence interval. It cannot establish empirical 1% error control, held-out superiority or a general SOTA claim.
